items.user_story_text: As a customer, I want to complete checkout so that my order can be processed.
items.free_scenario_text: The customer opens the cart, enters a shipping address, selects a payment method, and confirms the order.
items.expected_gherkin:
Feature: Checkout
  Scenario: Successful order checkout
    Given the customer has 1 product in the Cart
    When the customer clicks the Checkout button
    And the customer enters "1 Merdeka Street" in the Shipping Address
    And the customer selects "Bank Transfer" as the Payment Method
    And the customer clicks the Confirm button
    Then the order is recorded with the status "Awaiting Payment"

items.user_story_text: As a customer, I want checkout to be prevented when my cart is empty so that I do not create an empty order.
items.free_scenario_text: The customer clicks Checkout with an empty cart.
items.expected_gherkin:
Feature: Checkout
  Scenario: Checkout is rejected when the cart is empty
    Given the customer's Cart is empty
    When the customer clicks the Checkout button
    Then the Error message displays "The cart is still empty"
    And no order is created
acceptance_criteria: Error message displays cart is still empty
